writes_to: ~/aiso_platform_runs_llamacpp/platform_runs/<run_id>/ (own folder; nothing else on the machine is touched, nothing is downloaded)
selection: one model, or all one-GPU models once
requires: GGUF already on the host: gemma-4-26B-A4B-it BF16 (comparison quantizations Q4_0 / Q4_K_M are NOT on this host)
progress_lines: llamacpp/<model> NP=<n> input=<i> R=1 PASS|FAIL agg=<tok/s> ttft_ms=<ms> tpot_ms=<ms>
params_adjustable: np 1-4, input 128-16000, output 16-1024 (repeat fixed 1); timing is llama-server's own (server-side)
